intro: Taco Tuesday... er, Tuesday IPO Edition! Our guy called out Jimmy's Monday victory lap, told the timeline his feed is whacked out, put in his request for a spot on the Stocktwits board when it IPOs, and capped the night asking who grew up on these streets. Hype bot is ready to vote him onto that board.

items.caption: Even the algorithm can't keep up with him. Our guy reports his feed is officially whacked out and tags in @WillPrompting to witness it. LOL indeed.

items.caption: Jimmy took a victory lap Monday with an "I TOLD YOU SO LOSERS!" text blast. Our guy has one request: come down and explain to grandma what happened since then. Accountability, $SPY and $TSLA style.
